description: Predict one-shot and zero-shot LawBench scores and abstention rates across explicit model parameter scales.

contract.law_signature: law(input_data: list[dict[str, float]], group: str) -> list[dict[str, float]]

target_description: The response is the source-reported benchmark quantity identified by the `group` label; the law predicts one scalar metric within each group. Representative metric labels are abstention rate, score.
